title: List a User's Event Types
knowledge:
# List a User's Event Types ## Prerequisites - OAuth app/token must have the required scope: `event_types:read` ## Method `GET` ## URL `https://api.calendly.com/event_types` ## Headers ```json { "Accept": "application/json" } ``` ## Description Returns all Event Types associated with a specified User or Organization. You must provide **either** `organization` **or** `user` as a query parameter to scope the results. ## Enforcement Rules - **At least one** of these query parameters **must** be provided: `organization` or `user`. - Do **not** call this endpoint without `organization` and without `user`. - `user_availability_schedule` is only valid **in conjunction with** `user`. - When executing the action, ensure to send **Query Parameters** in the URL as query parameters and **not** in the body. - This endpoint has **no request body**. ### Valid Examples ```http /event_types?user=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.calendly.com%2Fusers%2FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA /event_types?organization=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.calendly.com%2Forganizations%2FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA /event_types?user=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.calendly.com%2Fusers%2FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA&user_availability_schedule=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.calendly.com%2Fuser_availability_schedules%2FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA ``` ### Invalid Examples ```http /event_types /event_types?user_availability_schedule=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.calendly.com%2Fuser_availability_schedules%2FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA ``` ## Required Query Parameters | Parameter | Type | Description | |----------------|--------|-------------| | `organization` | string | **Required if `user` is not provided.** Organization URI. “View available personal, team, and organization event types associated with the organization's URI.” Format: URI. | | `user` | string | **Required if `organization` is not provided.** User URI. “View available personal, team, and organization event types associated with the user's URI.” Format: URI. | ## Optional Query Parameters | Parameter | Type | Description | |-----------------------------|---------|-------------| | `admin_managed` | boolean | Return only admin managed event types if `true`, exclude admin managed event types if `false`, or include all event types if omitted. | | `user_availability_schedule`| string | URI. **Used in conjunction with `user`**; returns a filtered list of Event Types that use the given primary availability schedule. | | `active` | boolean | Return only active event types if `true`, only inactive if `false`, or all event types if omitted. | | `count` | number | Number of rows to return. Min `1`, max `100`. Default: `20`. | | `page_token` | string | Token to pass to get the next or previous portion of the collection. | | `sort` | string | Order results by field and direction. Accepts a comma-separated list of `{field}:{direction}`. Supported fields: `name`, `position`, `created_at`, `updated_at`. Directions: `asc`, `desc`. Default: `name:asc`. Example: `name`. | ## Response ### Success Response (200 OK) ```json { "collection": [ { "uri": "https://api.calendly.com/event_types/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA", "name": "15 Minute Meeting", "active": true, "booking_method": "instant", "slug": "acmesales", "scheduling_url": "https://calendly.com/acmesales", "duration": 15, "duration_options": [1, 13, 15, 720], "kind": "solo", "pooling_type": "round_robin", "type": "StandardEventType", "color": "#fff200", "created_at": "2019-01-02T03:04:05.678123Z", "updated_at": "2019-08-07T06:05:04.321123Z", "internal_note": "Internal note", "is_paid": false, "description_plain": "15 Minute Meeting", "description_html": "

15 Minute Meeting

", "profile": { "type": "User", "name": "Tamara Jones", "owner": "https://api.calendly.com/users/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" }, "secret": true, "deleted_at": null, "admin_managed": false, "locations": [ { "kind": "inbound_call", "phone_number": "+ 380934567654", "additional_info": "Additional information about location" } ], "position": 0, "custom_questions": [ { "name": "Company Name", "type": "string", "position": 0, "enabled": true, "required": true, "answer_choices": [], "include_other": false }, { "name": "What would you like to discuss?", "type": "text", "position": 0, "enabled": true, "required": true, "answer_choices": [], "include_other": false }, { "name": "Number of employees", "answer_choices": ["1", "2-10", "11-20", "20+"], "enabled": true, "include_other": true, "position": 2, "required": false, "type": "single_select" }, { "name": "Multi-Select Question", "answer_choices": ["Answer 1", "Answer 2", "Answer 3", "Answer 4"], "enabled": true, "include_other": true, "position": 2, "required": false, "type": "multi_select" }, { "name": "Phone Number", "type": "phone_number", "position": 0, "enabled": true, "required": true, "answer_choices": [], "include_other": false } ], "locale": "en" } ], "pagination": { "count": 20, "next_page": "https://api.calendly.com/event_types?count=1&page_token=sNjq4TvMDfUHEl7zHRR0k0E1PCEJWvdi", "previous_page": "https://api.calendly.com/event_types?count=1&page_token=VJs2rfDYeY8ahZpq0QI1O114LJkNjd7H", "next_page_token": "sNjq4TvMDfUHEl7zHRR0k0E1PCEJWvdi", "previous_page_token": "VJs2rfDYeY8ahZpq0QI1O114LJkNjd7H" } } ``` ### Error Responses #### 400 Bad Request ```json { "message": "Bad Request" } ``` #### 401 Unauthorized ```json { "message": "Unauthorized" } ``` #### 403 Forbidden ```json { "message": "Forbidden" } ``` #### 404 Not Found ```json { "message": "Not Found" } ``` #### 500 Internal Server Error ```json { "message": "Internal Server Error" } ``` ## Response Fields | Field | Type | Description | |------|------|-------------| | `collection` | array | Service response collection: array of Event Types. | | `collection[].active` | boolean | Indicates if the event is active or not. | | `collection[].admin_managed` | boolean | Indicates if this event type is managed by an organization admin. | | `collection[].booking_method` | string | Indicates if the event type is for a poll or an instant booking. Allowed values: `instant`, `poll`. | | `collection[].color` | string | Hexadecimal color value of the scheduling page. Pattern: `^#[a-f\\d]{6}$`. | | `collection[].created_at` | string | Date-time when the event type was created (ISO 8601). | | `collection[].custom_questions` | array | Array of `EventTypeCustomQuestion`. | | `collection[].deleted_at` | string \| null | Date-time when the event type was deleted (ISO 8601) or `null`. | | `collection[].description_html` | string \| null | Description formatted with HTML. | | `collection[].description_plain` | string \| null | Description as plain text. | | `collection[].duration` | number | Length of sessions booked with this event type (minutes). | | `collection[].duration_options` | array(integer) \| null | Array of duration options; always `null` for adhoc event types. | | `collection[].internal_note` | string \| null | Contents of an internal note associated with the event type. | | `collection[].is_paid` | boolean | Indicates whether the event type is paid. | | `collection[].kind` | string | Event type kind. Allowed values: `solo`, `group`. | | `collection[].locale` | string | Locale used to determine scheduling page language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`, `es`, `de`, `nl`, `pt`, `it`, `uk`. | | `collection[].locations` | array \| null | Configuration information for each possible location for this Event Type. | | `collection[].name` | string \| null | Human-readable event type name. | | `collection[].pooling_type` | string \| null | Allowed values: `round_robin`, `collective`, `multi_pool`, `null`. | | `collection[].position` | integer | Position order of Event Type, starting with 0. | | `collection[].profile` | object \| null | Publicly visible profile of a User or Team associated with the Event Type. | | `collection[].profile.type` | string | Profile type (example shows `User`). | | `collection[].profile.name` | string | Profile name. | | `collection[].profile.owner` | string | URI of the profile owner. | | `collection[].scheduling_url` | string | Scheduling page URL where invitees book the event type. | | `collection[].secret` | boolean | Indicates if the event type is hidden on the owner's main scheduling page. | | `collection[].slug` | string \| null | Human-readable portion of the event type URL. | | `collection[].type` | string | Allowed values: `StandardEventType`, `AdhocEventType`. | | `collection[].updated_at` | string | Date-time when the event type was last updated (ISO 8601). | | `collection[].uri` | string | Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the event type (URI). | | `pagination` | object | Pagination metadata. | | `pagination.count` | integer | The number of rows returned (0–100). | | `pagination.next_page` | string \| null | URI to return the next page of an ordered list, or `null`. | | `pagination.previous_page` | string \| null | URI to return the previous page of an ordered list, or `null`. | | `pagination.next_page_token` | string \| null | Token to return the next page, or `null`. | | `pagination.previous_page_token` | string \| null | Token to return the previous page, or `null`. | ## Sample Request ```bash curl --request GET \ --url 'https://api.calendly.com/event_types?user=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.calendly.com%2Fusers%2FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA&count=20&sort=name:asc' \ --header 'Accept: application/json' ``` ## Example Usage ### Example 1: List event types for a user (only active) ```bash curl --request GET \ --url 'https://api.calendly.com/event_types?user=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.calendly.com%2Fusers%2FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA&active=true' \ --header 'Accept: application/json' ``` ### Example 2: List event types for an organization (admin-managed only) ```bash curl --request GET \ --url 'https://api.calendly.com/event_types?organization=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.calendly.com%2Forganizations%2FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA&admin_managed=true' \ --header 'Accept: application/json' ``` ### Example 3: Filter by a user’s primary availability schedule ```bash curl --request GET \ --url 'https://api.calendly.com/event_types?user=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.calendly.com%2Fusers%2FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA&user_availability_schedule=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.calendly.com%2Fuser_availability_schedules%2FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA' \ --header 'Accept: application/json' ``` ## Notes - Either `organization` or `user` is required to use this endpoint. - `count` defaults to `20` and cannot exceed `100`. - Use `page_token` to paginate; `pagination.next_page_token` / `pagination.previous_page_token` in the response provide tokens for navigation. ## Error Handling - **400**: Invalid or missing required query scoping (e.g., neither `organization` nor `user` provided). - **401**: Missing/invalid OAuth token. - **403**: Authenticated but not permitted (e.g., missing `event_types:read` scope). - **404**: Referenced resources not found (e.g., invalid URIs). - **500**: Server-side error.
